chitchat: swings the flak gun a few degrees and eyeballs the sky down the barrel.
"She's older than me and twice as mean. Point her up, pull, duck."
description: A soot-black Slagworks hand welded into the flak gun's cradle, ear defenders round his neck and a dead roll-up in his lip. He fires the old gun on feel more than optics.

bye.text: They turn back to the guns and the sky.

root.text: They keep one eye on the sky. "Unless you're here to help work the guns, you're in the way. Move."

name: a Slagworks flak gunner
